# Digitum Markdown Viewer

> Free online markdown viewer and editor by Digitum Marketing. Open .md files in the browser, edit them with a live preview, and export to PDF, HTML, styled HTML, PNG or Markdown. Files are processed on the user's device; nothing is uploaded unless the user creates a share link.

## Tools

- [Markdown viewer](https://markdown.digitum.marketing/): open and read any .md, .markdown, .mdx or .txt file, or a whole folder
- [Markdown editor](https://markdown.digitum.marketing/markdown-editor): split view with live preview, formatting toolbar, synced selection and scrolling
- [Markdown to PDF](https://markdown.digitum.marketing/markdown-to-pdf): print-ready PDF with selectable text, paper size, margins and page numbers
- [Markdown to HTML](https://markdown.digitum.marketing/markdown-to-html): clean HTML, styled self-contained HTML, or formatted text for Gmail, Google Docs and WordPress
- [Markdown cheat sheet](https://markdown.digitum.marketing/markdown-cheat-sheet): syntax reference with live examples

## Supports

GitHub Flavored Markdown (tables, task lists, strikethrough, fenced code with syntax highlighting), LaTeX maths via KaTeX, Mermaid diagrams, short share links and embeds, light and dark themes, installable offline app.
